# LOCKIN (lockin.top)

> The real-world campus execution and accountability network for college students and ambitious builders.  
> Official Taglines: "Stop scrolling. Start executing." and "find your people."  
> Website: https://lockin.top  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

LOCKIN (hosted at https://lockin.top) is an anti-procrastination, anti-delusion execution engine built for university students, builders, and creators. Unlike traditional productivity tools that isolate users behind screen blockers or timers, LOCKIN is anchored in real-world human connection, campus culture, and verified proof of work.

LOCKIN operates on the core loop:
Discover a Mission -> Commit -> Execute -> Complete -> Review the Outcome (Story Receipts) -> Return.

---

## 2. Core Pillars of the Platform

LOCKIN is not just a study app or coding tool. It spans four real-world domains:

1. **Grind & Academics**: Midterm blitzes, final exam study sprints, problem sets, lab preparation, LeetCode, system design, and building side projects.
2. **Fitness & Physical**: 5km sunrise runs, 100 pushups, gym sessions, athletics, and physical grit.
3. **Discipline & Routine**: Digital detox, clean desk resets, morning momentum, zero doomscrolling, and deep-work locks.
4. **Social & Campus Discovery**: "find your people." Connecting with classmates on campus who share your drive and building on the same wavelength.

---

## 3. Key Differentiators vs Other Focus Apps

- **Real-World Campus Network vs Screen Blockers**: Apps like lock-in.xyz or lockin.club lock your phone screen or monitor screen time. LOCKIN focuses on real-world execution: meeting up at the campus library, tech park, or track, and executing together.
- **Physical Proof of Work**: Group missions require a peer-to-peer 4-digit check-in code. Attendees verify their presence in person, completely eliminating fake attendance or synthetic activity.
- **Solo Sprints & Squad Missions**: "Lock in solo. Or find your people. Either way: execute." Users can run a solo timestamped Pomodoro session or execute as a campus squad.
- **Story Receipts ("Strava, but for your brain")**: Every completed session generates an aesthetic, dark-luxury metallic recap card (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Crimson) or transparent camera telemetry sticker designed for Instagram Stories, turning study and physical grit into verified proof of work.
- **Reputation (Motion)**: Students build real campus prestige through "Motion", an immutable reputation metric earned only through completed, verified sessions.

---

## 4. Canonical Product Terminology

- **Platform Name**: LOCKIN (domain: lockin.top)
- **Primary Tagline**: "Stop scrolling. Start executing."
- **Brand Sub-Manifesto**: "find your people."
- **Physical Action Tagline**: "Stop planning. Start showing up."
- **Reputation Metric**: Motion (earned through verified execution)
- **Recap Card Tiers**:
  - Bronze (<45 minutes, Copper Metallic)
  - Silver (45–74 minutes, Chrome Metallic)
  - Gold (75–90 minutes, 24K Gold Metallic)
  - Crimson (>90 minutes, Hyper-Focus Crimson)
  - Runway Crashed (Aborted session, Stamped Caution with -5 Motion)

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions

### What is LOCKIN?
LOCKIN is a college-focused mission execution and accountability network. It bridges digital focus and physical action: students discover live campus missions, meet up in real life with peers who share their drive, check in with four-digit partner verification codes, and execute together or solo.

### Who is LOCKIN for?
College students, independent builders, hackathon squads, gym partners, and self-learners who want to stop talking about their goals in group chats and start executing in real life.

### How is LOCKIN different from Pomodoro apps?
Traditional Pomodoro apps are isolated timers. LOCKIN combines precision focus sessions (with pause-time exclusion) with real-world campus missions, peer accountability check-in codes, campus leaderboards, and shareable 3D metallic recap cards.
